liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Ferocious performance punctuated by seriously growling Hammond work from Brent; Great interplay between Jerry and Brent, with Brent driving the music [8][9]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Brent screams over Bobby, showing he was feeling it on this night [7]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Garcia sings with confidence and pride, making the song electric [15]
- **Althea** (1 review): Jerry shreds strings and sings with a super smooth voice throughout [7]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (1 review): Garcia plays scorching leads throughout the song, making it a top version [13]
- **Spanish Jam** (1 review): A very Spanish jam transitions into a bossa nova style Other One [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-10-19.131801.mtx-fix.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 172 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd81-10-19.sbd.macdonald.7914.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 168 min; rated 4.13/5 by 15 [3]. Said about its sound: The board sounds nice, though the tape quality could be better; Brent is very forward in the mix while Bobby is virtually nonexistent; SBD hiss is a bit distracting but does not dampen the show [8][9][12]
- **gd1981-10-19.sbd.miller.95781.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 166 min; rated 3.82/5 by 11 [4]. Said about its sound: Phil is not in the mix for the first few songs of the set [4]
- **gd1981-10-19.stankiewicz.patched.131522.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 171 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- The show is overshadowed by the classic October 16, 1981 performance [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-10-19.131801.mtx-fix.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:095781) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD -> EAC -> SHN; Transfer Info: SHN ->… [1]
- **gd81-10-19.sbd.macdonald.7914.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1981-10-19.sbd.miller.95781.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD -> EAC ->SHN [4]. Also: A tape flip between Space and Drums was cleaned up with a crossfade [4]
- **gd1981-10-19.stankiewicz.patched.131522.flac1644**: taped by Richie Stankiewicz; transferred by Richie Stankiewicz; source: Source: Beyer M-160>Sony TC-D5M. Transfer 1st set: MAC > Sony TC-K3es > USBPre2. Transfer 2nd set: 1st Gen > Sony TC-K3es > USBPre2. Recorded center directly… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Poster - Sports Palace, Spain](https://www.dead.net/archives/1981/artwork/poster-sports-palace-spain) [20]
